title: Sort Integers by The Number of 1 Bits
description: Sort an array of integers in ascending order based on the number of 1 bits in their binary representation.

steps.note: Compare 0 (0 bits) and 1 (1 bit). Since 0 < 1, order remains.
Compare 1 (1 bit) and 2 (1 bit). Bits equal, sort by value: 1 < 2.
Compare 2 (1 bit) and 3 (2 bits). Since 1 bit < 2 bits, 2 comes before 3.
